impact.text: ERC-20 non-compliance – automated tooling may treat the token as invalid or malfunction when reconstructing balances from events.

precondition_sources.text: A spender calls TokenWrapper.transferFrom, supplying an approved token owner as the from parameter.

intent_sources.text: The Transfer event emitted by transferFrom must identify in its from field the token holder whose balance decreases (the approved token owner), not the spender.
